detailed_description:
The target video is a live-action, cinematic slice-of-life sequence with warm natural light and a slightly handheld documentary feel, with no on-screen text anywhere.
[Shot 1] The video opens from <Picture 1>, a medium shot of <Subject 1>, the slightly stocky young man with short black hair, a friendly round face, and a plain white short-sleeve T-shirt, standing on a sunlit old-city sidewalk before a quiet residential street with trees, a parked vehicle, and a low building. The camera holds a slightly handheld static frame as a black-and-white football drops into the top of the frame. <Subject 1> flicks his right foot upward; the ball grazes the top of his instep, ricochets awkwardly, and bounces high to the right. He lunges two quick steps after it, watches it roll away, then plants his feet and lifts his right hand to scratch the back of his head. Turning back to the camera with a sheepish grin, the young man (S1) mutters to himself in a low, self-mocking tone, <d>[Chinese] 哎，失误了。</d>
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to a low-angle close-up at ground level as the black-and-white football rolls along the sidewalk and stops under the toe of a white canvas sneaker. The camera tilts up at slow speed to reveal <Subject 2>, the young woman with an oval face, a soft smile, bare shoulders, a white thin-strapped camisole, and a high bun. She bends at the waist, reaches down with both hands, and lifts the ball, then straightens back up as her bun bounces lightly. Holding the ball against her chest, the young woman (S2) turns toward <Subject 1> with a bright, amused laugh and teases him in a playful, breathy tone, <d>[Chinese] 球都踢不好，还想赢我？</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:06.500, the shot cuts to a low-angle medium shot of <Subject 3>, the gleaming 2026 FIFA World Cup Trophy with its spiraling golden body, two human-figure handles, and emerald-green malachite base, resting at chest height. The camera arcs around the trophy in a half-circle, revealing <Subject 1> cradling it against his chest as ribbons and confetti burst behind him, golden particles drift through warm rim light, and the polished surface catches lens flares. <Subject 2> steps into the right side of the frame, clapping her hands above her chest and laughing. He glances down at the trophy, then turns his eyes toward her, gives a small wink, and says in a warm, slightly playful voice, <d>[Chinese] 赢不了全世界，也想在你这里赢一次。</d> The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, and the video ends on a medium close-up of the two of them.

A football impacts the foot and bounces, followed by two quick footsteps on asphalt, a soft brush of cotton fabric, and a quiet exhale. The ball then rolls across asphalt and bumps softly against a canvas sneaker, with fabric rustling as hands grip the leather. After a sharp referee whistle and a thundering crowd roar that drops to a murmur, confetti rattles through the air and a bright female laugh rings out.
